displayName: Corp, the corporate identity provider stood in
passwordPolicy: length(12) and maxLength(128) and digits(1) and lowerCase(1) and upperCase(1) and specialChars(1) and notUsername and notEmail and passwordHistory(5)

clientScopes.name: corp-claims
clientScopes.description: What Corp says about a person that kloakware maps: the market and the Steward role.

clients.name: Kloakware's steward realm, as an OpenID Connect relying party
clients.description: The broker in the steward realm signs people in here and maps what Corp says about them. Confidential, code flow with PKCE, nothing else.

clients.name: Kloakware's steward realm, as a SAML service provider
clients.description: The SAML broker in the steward realm, by its entity id. Assertions signed, responses by POST, the email as the subject.
